scope: Exact published dependency metadata/archive verification; not a build

crates.name: tokio-postgres
crates.metadata:
tokio-postgres #database #postgres #postgresql #sql #async
A native, asynchronous PostgreSQL client
version: 0.7.18
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
rust-version: 1.85
documentation: https://docs.rs/tokio-postgres/0.7.18
repository: https://github.com/rust-postgres/rust-postgres
crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/tokio-postgres/0.7.18
features:
 +default            = [runtime]
  runtime            = [tokio/net, tokio/time]
  array-impls        = [postgres-types/array-impls]
  js                 = [postgres-protocol/js, postgres-types/js]
  with-bit-vec-0_6   = [postgres-types/with-bit-vec-0_6]
  with-bit-vec-0_7   = [postgres-types/with-bit-vec-0_7]
  with-bit-vec-0_8   = [postgres-types/with-bit-vec-0_8]
  with-bit-vec-0_9   = [postgres-types/with-bit-vec-0_9]
  with-chrono-0_4    = [postgres-types/with-chrono-0_4]
  with-cidr-0_2      = [postgres-types/with-cidr-0_2]
  with-cidr-0_3      = [postgres-types/with-cidr-0_3]
  with-eui48-0_4     = [postgres-types/with-eui48-0_4]
  with-eui48-1       = [postgres-types/with-eui48-1]
  with-geo-types-0_6 = [postgres-types/with-geo-types-0_6]
  with-geo-types-0_7 = [postgres-types/with-geo-types-0_7]
  with-jiff-0_1      = [postgres-types/with-jiff-0_1]
  with-jiff-0_2      = [postgres-types/with-jiff-0_2]
  with-serde_json-1  = [postgres-types/with-serde_json-1]
  with-smol_str-01   = [postgres-types/with-smol_str-01]
  with-time-0_2      = [postgres-types/with-time-0_2]
  with-time-0_3      = [postgres-types/with-time-0_3]
  with-uuid-0_8      = [postgres-types/with-uuid-0_8]
  with-uuid-1        = [postgres-types/with-uuid-1]

crates.name: deadpool
crates.metadata:
deadpool #async #database #pool
Dead simple async pool
version: 0.13.1
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
rust-version: 1.85
documentation: https://docs.rs/deadpool/0.13.1
repository: https://github.com/deadpool-rs/deadpool
crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/deadpool/0.13.1
features:
 +default        = [managed, unmanaged]
  managed        = []
  unmanaged      = []
  rt_async-std_1 = [deadpool-runtime/async-std_1]
  rt_smol_2      = [deadpool-runtime/smol_2]
  rt_tokio_1     = [deadpool-runtime/tokio_1]
  serde          = [dep:serde]

crates.name: tokio-postgres-rustls
crates.metadata:
tokio-postgres-rustls
Rustls integration for tokio-postgres
version: 0.14.0
license: MIT
rust-version: unknown
documentation: https://docs.rs/tokio-postgres-rustls/0.14.0
repository: https://github.com/jbg/tokio-postgres-rustls
crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/tokio-postgres-rustls/0.14.0
features:
 +default      = []
  aws-lc-rs    = [rustls/aws_lc_rs, tokio-rustls/aws_lc_rs]
  native-certs = [dep:rustls-native-certs]
  ring         = [rustls/ring, tokio-rustls/ring]
  webpki-roots = [dep:webpki-roots]

crates.name: rustls
crates.metadata:
rustls
Rustls is a modern TLS library written in Rust.
version: 0.23.46 (latest 0.24.0-dev.2)
license: Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT
rust-version: 1.71
documentation: https://docs.rs/rustls/0.23.46
homepage: https://github.com/rustls/rustls
repository: https://github.com/rustls/rustls
crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/rustls/0.23.46
features:
 +default             = [aws_lc_rs, logging, prefer-post-quantum, std, tls12]
  aws_lc_rs           = [dep:aws-lc-rs, webpki/aws-lc-rs, aws-lc-rs/aws-lc-sys, aws-lc-rs/prebuilt-nasm]
  log                 = [dep:log]
  logging             = [log]
  prefer-post-quantum = [aws_lc_rs]
  std                 = [webpki/std, pki-types/std, once_cell/std]
  tls12               = []
  aws-lc-rs           = [aws_lc_rs]
  brotli              = [dep:brotli, dep:brotli-decompressor, std]
  custom-provider     = []
  fips                = [aws_lc_rs, aws-lc-rs?/fips, webpki/aws-lc-rs-fips]
  hashbrown           = [dep:hashbrown]
  read_buf            = [rustversion, std]
  ring                = [dep:ring, webpki/ring]
  rustversion         = [dep:rustversion]
  zlib                = [dep:zlib-rs]
crates.index_refresh: note: to see how you depend on rustls, run `cargo tree --invert rustls@0.23.46`

crates.name: rustls-pki-types
crates.metadata:
rustls-pki-types
Shared types for the rustls PKI ecosystem
version: 1.15.1
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
rust-version: 1.60
documentation: https://docs.rs/rustls-pki-types
homepage: https://github.com/rustls/pki-types
repository: https://github.com/rustls/pki-types
crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/rustls-pki-types/1.15.1
features:
 +default  = [alloc]
  alloc    = [dep:zeroize]
  std      = [alloc]
  web      = [web-time]
  web-time = [dep:web-time]
